description: This Java class 'JsonExamplesProducer' generates example JSON files related to searching and modeling 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for producing JSON representations of search models, commands, responses, and errors, mainly for testing or sample purposes.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates various JSON files representing search models, commands, responses, and errors for testing or documentation purposes within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, invokes the JSON production process based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates arguments and initiates production of JSON files in the specified directory.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Orchestrates the production of search model, commands, responses, and exceptions in designated subfolders.

methods.name: produceSearchModel
methods.description: Creates sample search model JSON and writes it to the specified directory.

methods.name: produceSearchCommands
methods.description: Creates sample search command JSON files.

methods.name: produceSearchCommandResponses
methods.description: Creates sample responses JSON files for search commands.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a file with optional schema versioning.
